note: P4352 (Pro 29:19) — a servant is not disciplined by mere words; though he understands, he will not respond.

dims.v: obstinate non-compliance — grasping the word yet refusing to obey
the servant who understands but will not respond — the obstinacy that grasps the meaning of a rebuke yet deliberately withholds obedience, so that mere words cannot correct him
(the words that fail to move him)
the willful refusal to act on what one fully understands

bin (understand) — 'for though he UNDERSTANDS, he will not respond'; some are not moved by words alone — they grasp the correction and refuse it. Understanding without will to obey is a hardness words cannot reach (cf 29:1).
